snapshot_note: Balances/config read live around block ~116.44M / 2026-08-17. Re-read before relying on state.

target.name: STYTOKEN (SWAN TREASURY / STY)
target.notes: 18 decimals, totalSupply 9,999,990. Custom _transfer applies buy/sell/profit/burn fees routed to FeeCutter, plus a permissionless 1%/round AMM-pool skim to MinerRewardContract.

value_path_contracts.name: FeeCutter
value_path_contracts.source_available: YES - identical contract source is in the VERIFIED STYTOKEN.sol (same compilation unit); deployed bytecode function-set confirmed by decompilation
value_path_contracts.role: Receives STY fees skimmed by STYTOKEN._transfer; swaps STY->USDT via PancakeRouter and distributes to fee owners; also splits burn/profit cuts.

value_path_contracts.name: MinerRewardContract
value_path_contracts.role: Receives 1%/round STY skim from STYTOKEN.cutAmmPoolToMinerReward + fee addReward() calls. Staking/reward hub: order(uint256) permissionless staking (amount>100), signature-gated claim(s) via ecrecover against a signer.

value_path_contracts.name: FeeOwnerNode
value_path_contracts.role: Node reward pool. Receives USDT from FeeCutter (CutSellFee/CutProfit) and addReward(). claim(uint256,uint256,uint256,string) gated by ecrecover==signer; reads balanceOf/tokenOfOwnerByIndex on 3 hardcoded STYNODE NFT contracts.

value_path_contracts.name: FeeOwnerTeam
value_path_contracts.role: Team reward pool. Receives USDT from FeeCutter (CutSellFee/CutProfit) and addReward(). Signature-gated claim.

value_path_contracts.name: MarketMaker (MarketNumber1) [FeeCutter.TeamA]
value_path_contracts.role: Automated market maker: AutoBuy()/AutoSell() (onlyCaller) swap STY<->USDT via PancakeRouter to defend a price band (openPrice*1.03). Also a burn-cut recipient of STY from FeeCutter.cutSellBurn.

value_path_contracts.name: BigPool (OrderBIGPOOL)
value_path_contracts.role: Holds the bulk STY treasury (7.67M STY = ~77% of supply). AddLiqlidity(uint256) (onlyLocker) pulls USDT from caller, pairs it with BigPool's STY, adds LP to PancakeRouter with LP sent to the LiquidityHolder. No STY-rescue path.

value_path_contracts.name: LiquidityHolder (LiqlidityHolder)
value_path_contracts.role: Holds the STY/USDT LP tokens (~1.4M LP). ReedeemLP(...) lets a user remove liquidity, gated by ecrecover==_signer (an off-chain backend key). owner can takeOutErrorTransfer any token.

value_path_contracts.name: FeeOwnerCollege (Gnosis Safe proxy, 2-of-2)
value_path_contracts.role: Fee recipient (USDT from CutBuyFee/CutSellFee/CutProfit; STY from cutSellBurn). Gnosis Safe v1.3.0.

value_path_contracts.name: TeamB (Gnosis Safe proxy, 2-of-2)
value_path_contracts.role: Profit-cut USDT recipient (FeeCutter.CutProfit). Gnosis Safe v1.3.0.

reward_subsystem_periphery.name: NodeStoreH
reward_subsystem_periphery.role: Helper referenced by FeeOwnerNode (be95492b). Hardcodes the same 3 STYNODE NFT addresses. Recovered by decompilation.

reward_subsystem_periphery.name: STYNODE1 NFT
reward_subsystem_periphery.role: ERC721 node membership. owner=deployer 0xd8d76d04. totalSupply 376. Byte-identical to STYNODE2 clones.

reward_subsystem_periphery.name: MinerReward_helper
reward_subsystem_periphery.role: Small (1454b) helper referenced by MinerRewardContract. Recovered by decompilation.

reward_subsystem_periphery.name: MinerReward reward-pool variant
reward_subsystem_periphery.role: 3628b reward pool referenced by MinerRewardContract, distinct bytecode from FeeOwnerTeam-shape. Recovered by decompilation.

reward_subsystem_periphery.name: Reward treasury (Gnosis Safe proxy, 2-of-2)
reward_subsystem_periphery.role: Referenced by MinerRewardContract (slot16). Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 with the SAME 2 owners as College/TeamB.

key_eoas.role: Deployer. FeeCutter.superowner (can retarget all fee recipients + operators). Owner of all 3 STYNODE NFT contracts (can mint node NFTs => reward eligibility).
Owner of MinerRewardContract, FeeOwnerNode, FeeOwnerTeam (can set signer + reward parameters on the reward pools).
Signer for the reward pools (MinerReward/Node/Team). Its ECDSA key authorizes reward claims. OFF-CHAIN KEY.
Signer for LiquidityHolder.ReedeemLP. Its ECDSA key authorizes LP redemptions => USDT payouts. OFF-CHAIN KEY.
Gnosis Safe owner #1 (College / TeamB / RewardTreasury multisig, 2-of-2).
Gnosis Safe owner #2 (College / TeamB / RewardTreasury multisig, 2-of-2).
